meta.name: ALDEA World: the Council governs the official version
meta.description: Hands ALDEA World's governor in the Atlas to AldeaCouncilExecutor. From then on only a Council result that passed its delay without a veto can set the official version; the Safe keeps the veto (it is the executor's guardian). There is no way back through the executor: do this when the Charter is about to open. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>.
